counterparty: PT Abadi Jaya Sakti and PT Tigamitra Ekamulia (related parties)
consideration_basis: Gross sales consideration for the divestment of 100% of PT Karya Sentra Sejahtera per Interested Person Transactions table: S$25,908,000 (p200). Net-of-tax proceeds / net cash flow on disposal S$22,440,000 (Note 30, p197). Prior value 22,440,000 was the net figure conflated into the gross column.
notes: Completed 4 Dec 2025 via disposal of 100% of PT Karya Sentra Sejahtera (holding co) by indirect subsidiaries Lovage International and IAHCC Investment, to related parties PT Abadi Jaya Sakti and PT Tigamitra Ekamulia. Gross sales consideration for the divestment S$25,908,000 (Interested Person Transactions table, p200). Total sales consideration net of tax / net cash flow on disposal S$22,440,000 (Note 30, p197). Carrying amount of net assets disposed S$25,627,000; loss on disposal S$7,535,000 (incl. S$5,193,000 FX reserve realisation). FY2024 carrying value S$27,723,000. Manager's divestment fee payable in units S$130,000 (Note 30 p197 / IPT p200). No separate independent deal valuation disclosed in the AR.
